purpose: One-shot falsification audit of transfer to modern generators after controlling image content and source identity as far as feasible.

matching.method: Global unique assignment from each actual fake-image embedding to one fresh COCO train2017 real image.
matching.limitation: CLIP similarity reduces content mismatch but does not prove that every pair is semantically identical or that every remaining shortcut is removed.

rejected_predecessors.reason: The stripped-down timm vision loader produced different feature values and changed 65 of 144 assignments on a nominally identical rebuild.

metrics: paired accuracy: fraction of pairs where the fake score exceeds its matched real score
per-prompt ROC AUC and paired accuracy
per-generator matched ROC AUC and paired accuracy, reported as noisy diagnostics because each has only eight pairs
ROC AUC for every one of the 19 workshop transformations
official-style mean of clean and pooled transformed ROC AUC
decision_rule: This is a one-shot audit, not a tuning set. Do not change blend weights, threshold, preprocessing, augmentation, or training choices using these results. Passing every floor only means the current candidate survives this audit; it is not hidden-set proof. Any failed floor remains an explicit blocker and cannot be erased by averaging.
prohibitions: No organizer demo-only COCO val2017 or DALL-E Advanced image is present or used.
No gate row may be used for training, calibration, threshold selection, augmentation selection, or blend-weight selection.
No hidden-set performance claim may be made from this gate.
